verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart says the SDK transcription method accepts a local file, binary data, or a remote URL, so URL-based ingestion is a documented first-party capability. That one line does not make clear whether Gladia's service fetches the URL itself or the SDK downloads and uploads it, and signed URLs are never mentioned. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of server-side fetching from an API parameter (e.g. an audio_url field), documented support for signed/presigned URLs, details on URL limits or auth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
